collection_interpretation: Ready is registration status. The never-run status is not evidence of a successful real collection. The first acquisition remains scheduled; no manual launch was performed.
evidence_limits: Historical and reserved-cohort statements are source declarations explicitly classified as not reaudited; reserved cohorts were not opened.
Provider-outage labels are reported instrument findings; the empty-window census alone does not establish external causation.
The January 29 cell jump remains a reported audit statement, not a separately reproduced daily cell-count result.
Forecast accuracy is not profitability, dealer causality, historical client availability or independent confirmation.
Numeric equality is not semantic proof. Field selections and interpretations received a separate contextual review.
Summary sections are each sized for one page and separated by a page-break directive; pagination depends on the Markdown renderer.
